rules.text: Use only the Krishnamurti ayanamsa for KP; other values make the stellar results fail. The book’s own ayanamsa table (e.g. 23°15′ for 1963) matches the “Krishnamurti New” choice on this page, about 6′ less than Lahiri.
Planet-to-cusp distances are the same under any ayanamsa, so they cannot prove one. Only stellar timing can test it: known events must fall in the right dasa, star and sub.
Every chart in the Readers uses the mean node for Rahu, with Ketu exactly opposite. Choose the mean node in Settings to match the books’ star and sub lords.
A house runs from its cusp to the next cusp; the cusp is the exact start of the house. KP uses Placidus cusps, so houses are unequal and need not line up with the signs.
The Lagna moves about one degree every four minutes, faster in some signs. A birth time a few minutes out can change a cusp’s sub lord, so KP needs the time to the minute.
Each star of 13°20′ is split into nine unequal subs in Vimshottari proportion, starting with the star lord. The sub is what separates twins and people born minutes apart.
From 1 September 1942 to 15 October 1945 Indian clocks ran one hour ahead of IST (war time). A birth time recorded then may be war time; settle which before judging the chart.
Uranus and Neptune may be drawn in a chart, but KP leaves them out of star lordship, the dasa and the significator tables. Only the nine grahas count.
The star a planet occupies matters most: the results of its star lord, by the houses that lord holds and owns, mostly prevail over those of the planet’s own placement.

Lordship counts for more than a planet’s natural nature. Jupiter or Venus can do great harm when they sit in the stars of planets that own or occupy bad houses, and a natural malefic can do good the other way round.
Tradition holds a house is spoiled when its lord sits 6th, 8th or 12th from it. Krishnamurti rejects this sign count and asks for the exact distance between the points instead.
KP uses only the Vimshottari dasa, with years of 365¼ days (the solar year). Years of 360 days are only a shortcut for hand arithmetic.
